# Uncaught failures from Alembic or DB operations

Calls to alembic.command.upgrade and to the database via make_engine/Session are performed with no local exception handling. Errors raised by Alembic, DB connection failures, or SQL errors will propagate to the caller unhandled.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.upgrade_schema`
- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.register_repository`
